notes.title: 🌕 A Dream Channel Zero Room Appears in Wish Upon a Cat!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44135123/84d8bbbc6bf51617c963a4346bfba21abc74e807.png"][/img][/p][p]The eerie, nostalgic world of [i]Dream Channel Zero[/i] comes to life in a special collaboration room inside [i]Wish Upon a Cat[/i].[/p][p]Inside the room, you'll meet the mysterious Moon-faced Man.
Through your conversations with him, you’ll begin to feel the strange and hazy atmosphere of dreams and reality blending together.[/p][p]Whether you're already familiar with [i]Dream Channel Zero[/i] or it's your first time hearing about it,
this is the perfect opportunity to step into its world—just for a moment.[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857590/Wish_Upon_a_Cat/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
